purpose: Capture potentially valuable epistemic artefacts immediately, before warrant, understanding, novelty or commitment has been resolved.
principles: Capture latency should be low; judgment may take longer.
An intake record is not knowledge, validation, novelty, publication, priority or an Active Frontier commitment.
Unknown warrant and incomplete understanding are valid states, not missing-data errors.
Every artefact should retain a provenance pointer and an explicit next route.
Promotion consumes attention; capture should consume very little.

records.title: Epistemic artefact to frontier state model
records.summary: Provisional chain separating possibility, directed search, epistemic artefact, warrant, assimilation, capability and reachable frontier.
records.novelty_status: established terminology plus synthesis/application; novelty unassessed

records.title: Constitutional attention as adversarial evolutionary search
records.summary: A provisional architecture in which strategy-generating and adversarial populations co-evolve under a human-governed constitution of plural worthwhile-future objectives, hard constraints, escalation rules and retained historical failures.
records.novelty_status: competitive coevolution, constitutional oversight and selective-human-review antecedents; synthesis novelty unassessed

records.title: The Critical Scholar: AI as Academic Method
records.summary: MPhil programme that uses LLMs as examiner, adversary, conceptual microscope and metacognitive instrument to improve scholarly reasoning while testing durable human capability through unaided transfer after AI scaffolding is removed.
records.novelty_status: AI-literacy, metacognition, tutoring and learning-science antecedents expected; programme-level novelty unassessed
